nations.name: Cachil DeHe Band of Wintun Indians of the Colusa Indian Community

facts.text: On November 23, 1941, members of the Cachil DeHe Band ratified the community’s Constitution and By-Laws.
facts.evidence: were ratified and adopted by the Tribe’s original 45 members

facts.text: In 2004, the Colusa Indian Community Council published its first Cachil DeHe language book, a collaboration between Tribal Elders and University of California, Berkeley linguists.
facts.evidence: The project was a collaborative effort by Elders

facts.text: In a January 2023 report, the Colusa Indian Community Council said its Housing Energy Connection Project extended the Tribe’s electric distribution to 33 households.

source.title: Housing Energy Connection Project Final Technical Report
source.publisher: Colusa Indian Community Council via U.S. Department of Energy

facts.evidence: expanded existing medium-voltage distribution to 33 households
